name: Koutarou
source: The protagonist, who wants to get along with his daughter. After he discovered her stealing his money and speaked ill of him, Koutarou had the resolve to rape her until he was satisfied.[spoiler] Depending on the chosen route, he will be afflicted for what happened and will try to not do that again without her consent or he will keep raping her and deceive her in doing sexual favors.[/spoiler]
